motivation: Completed state_control_v1: axial orientation/spin swaps reduce first-impact disagreement only0.25percent; full object R/v restore reduces13.539to2.269mm,83.24percent. Warmstart changes negligible. Need distinguish other orientation vs velocity components.
sources: same20centers,80lawful0.1mm neighbors,first eligible event queries,unchanged physics/actions; original and neighbor native exact continuation controls repeated

definitions.orientation: all10pin quaternions from original, retain neighbor world angular velocities by converting into new body frames; retain positions/linear velocities
definitions.velocity: all10pin original world linear/angular velocities, neighbor pose retained
definitions.linear: only pin world linear velocities restored
definitions.angular: only pin world angular velocities restored, neighbor pose retained
definitions.transverse_angular: restore original world angular velocity projected perpendicular to each neighbor pin's long axis; retain neighbor axial component
definitions.target_pin_state: only first-impact target pin(s) quaternion and full velocity restored
definitions.other_pins_state: only non-target pins quaternion/full velocity restored
definitions.ball_state: only ball quaternion/full velocity restored; negative control if its original/neighbor state is identical
definitions.positions: all11 object positions restored; orientations/velocities unchanged
definitions.float32: original full native qpos/qvel rounded through float32 then converted back to float64; normalize all11quaternions, no other change. Measures numerical precision sensitivity, not an exact identical-input witness. Record active input coordinate changes.

analysis: same100ms raw endpoint displacement difference from original,4neighbors within episode then20episode macro;10000paired bootstrap seed20261022; all individual rows reported

decision.component_mediation: for each orientation,velocity,linear,angular,transverse-angle,target-only,other-only restore, report relative reduction and pairedCI vsneighbor_forward. A major component must reduce>=50percent and pairedCIupper<0. Multiple passes or interactions do not identify a unique single cause.
decision.precision: original float32 fork episode-macro>1mm requires further quantization controls before declaring float32 privileged input adequate.
decision.none: if no individual component passes despite combined R/v success, freeze a matched pose/velocity factorial interaction diagnostic; do not attribute failure to architecture by exclusion.

limits: Query forks need not be consistent with entire observed history.
These are sensitivity/mediation checks, not model generalization scores.
Do not change training targets, physical parameters or output coordinates based on these controls.
